q-0390.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0439.answer:
Surah Faatir (35) — The Originator · 45 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Believer and the Disbeliever are not equal
• That He may give them a reward for what they have done, and multiply it by adding more, such as has never occurred to them.
• Remember the Bad Consequences of disbelieving in the Prophets
• If He were to punish them for all of their sins, He would destroy all the people of the earth and all that they own of livestock and crops.

Surah Al-Alaq (96) — The Clot · 19 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• `indeed We will make it extremely black on the Day of Judgement.
• `unto Allah is the final destination and return, and He will hold you accountable for your wealth, as to where you obtained it from and how did you spend it.
• `O Muhammad! Do not obey him in what he is forbidding from such as steadfastness in worship and performing worship in abundance.
• His people and his tribe. In other words, let him call them in order to seek help from them.

q-4909.answer:
Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (84) — The Splitting Open · 25 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Splitting the Heavens asunder and stretching the Earth forth on the Day of Resurrection
• Inform them, O Muhammad, that Allah has prepared for them a painful torment.
• The Recompense for Deeds is True
• From their mannerism is rejection, obstinacy, and opposition to the truth.
• Certainly Allah will repeat his creation just as he began his creation, and He will reward him based upon his deeds, whether they were good or bad.

Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Tafsir maududi_ur 13:27: یہ لوگ جنہوں نے (رسالت محمدیؐ کو ماننے سے) انکار کر دیا ہے کہتے ہیں "اِس شخص پر اِس کے رب کی طرف سے کوئی نشانی کیوں نہ اتری" کہو، اللہ جسے چاہتا ہے گمراہ کر دیتا ہے اور وہ اپنی طرف آنے کا راستہ اُسی کو دکھاتا ہے جو اُس کی طرف رجوع کرے
